items.title: Submit ID copy and self-disclosure form (KYC update)
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie die Unterlagen binnen 8 Werktagen (Montag bis Samstag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens ein.
items.computation: The letter is dated Thursday 18.12.2025 and states the period runs after the date of this letter, so counting starts on 19.12.2025. Werktage are defined by the letter as Monday-Saturday excluding public holidays. Counting only Mon-Sat, skipping Sundays and NW public holidays (25.12.2025 Christmas Day, 26.12.2025 2nd Christmas Day): Werktag 1 = Fri 19.12; Werktag 2 = Sat 20.12; Sun 21.12 skipped; Werktag 3 = Mon 22.12; Werktag 4 = Tue 23.12; Werktag 5 = Wed 24.12; Thu 25.12 and Fri 26.12 are holidays, skipped; Werktag 6 = Sat 27.12; Sun 28.12 skipped; Werktag 7 = Mon 29.12; Werktag 8 = Tue 30.12.2025. Thus the 8th Werktag, and last day to submit the documents, is 30.12.2025.

warnings: The letter threatens to block the securities account for purchases if the identity document copy and self-disclosure form are not submitted in time; requests for ID copies under time pressure and threat of account restriction are a pattern also used in phishing scams, so verify this request is genuine (e.g. by calling the bank via the phone number on your bank card or a previously known number) before sending any ID copy or personal data.

Sender name, address (Musterfurt) and IBAN in the letterhead appear to be generic placeholder/template values rather than a specific real institution's details; confirm the sender's actual identity and official contact details before responding.
